sentences.text: This is our Track 1 system.
It plays the analyst: it reads each monitoring case and recommends close, request information, or escalate, citing the evidence it used.
One command takes an institution folder and writes one verdict per case.
A thousand cases take about two seconds.
Each line has a verdict, a reason code, a written reason and the evidence it cites.
sentences.say: Each line has a verdict, a reason code, a written reason, and the evidence it cites.

sentences.text: Every case takes four steps.
Explain the transactions from documents and history.
Look for concrete signs of suspicion.
Test each alert against its own rule: it is covered only when what stays unexplained is below that rule's threshold.
Then combine: suspicion escalates, a gap becomes one specific request, and otherwise the case closes.
Here is a held payment of £33,173.83 to Iraq.
sentences.say: Here is a held payment of thirty-three thousand pounds to Iraq.

sentences.text: The invoice names the same supplier, the same amount to the penny, and the same account and reference, so the payment can be released.
In a second case no invoice is on file, so the system asks for it.
In a third, the invoice shows a different amount.
That is a contradiction, so it goes to the MLRO.
sentences.say: That is a contradiction, so it goes to the M L R O.

sentences.text: Four decisions shaped the design.
One: check facts, not wording. A wrongful close costs the most, so a close needs proof.
Two: the decision logic is deterministic, and offline repeat runs are byte-identical.
sentences.say: Two: the decision logic is deterministic, and offline repeat runs are byte identical.

sentences.text: Three: one engine serves all four institutions; only policy settings differ.
Four: fail safe. A case that cannot be read is escalated alone, and the run continues.
If a key is supplied, a language model reads only documents no parser recognised.
It is an untrusted reader: each fact needs a word-for-word quote, and the same rules still decide.
sentences.say: It is an untrusted reader: each fact needs a word for word quote, and the same rules still decide.

sentences.text: Verdict, reason and evidence come from the same findings, so every answer traces to its source.
sentences.say: Verdict, reason, and evidence come from the same findings, so every answer traces to its source.
